name: ElegantFin TV
description: Minimal ElegantFin design with native Jellyfin motion and Media Bar focus support. Requires a compatible File Transformation plugin. LG C4 integration still requires on-device verification.

versions.changelog: Place native selection-dialog cancellation below the choices so it cannot cover titles or descriptions in Watch Together and hidden-media dialogs. Preserve the separate TV back icon. Hide password reset across personal profile page variants while retaining save and admin reset. Browser CSS is a separate release asset.

overview: ElegantFin for webOS and TV layouts
